data.title: Two Prime CEO Calls Bitcoin Yields From Babylon and Stacks ‘VC-Funded Subsidies’
data.description: Alexander Blume said the rewards that Babylon and Stacks offered bitcoin holders pay out less as deposits grow, and pointed to a vault Two Prime runs on Pareto that lends to borrowers offchain.
